title: Banach Gelfand Triples with Kernel Theorems via Equivalence Bimodules
summary: Hilbert C*-modules whose coefficient C*-algebra is equipped with a finite faithful trace generate Banach Gelfand triples. This provides a natural setting for the interpretation of Hilbert C*-modules as function spaces. In particular, when the modules are finitely generated and projective, their external tensor products interact well with projective tensor products. This allowed us to derive abstract kernel theorems for Hilbert C*-modules. As an application, we apply our results to Heisenberg modules and obtain new kernel theorems for time-frequency analysis.
